subject: Request: CAIQ + SOC 2 artifacts for APAC-only hosting and sample VPC egress logs
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthlink.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthLink Security Team <sec-team@healthlink.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 16:23:00 +0000
Subject: CAIQ + SOC2 artifacts for APAC-only hosting (HealthLink request)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week. HealthLink's security review needs a short package to confirm APAC-only hosting for our pilot. Specifically we need:

- Completed CAIQ answers (APAC variants noted where applicable).
- SOC 2 exhibit / snapshot referencing the 2026 controls we discussed.
- A short attestation (signed) that production data for our tenant will be hosted solely in the APAC region(s) we agreed on (Melbourne/Osaka), including fallback behaviour.
- A sample VPC egress log (redacted) showing no cross-border egress for a representative 24h window, plus a description of keystore handling and HSM/escrow flows.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the above by EOD Friday? If a signed attestation requires Docusign, please share a draft so we can circulate to procurement.

Appreciate it — Alicia

--
Alicia Gomez
Head of Security, HealthLink Inc
agomez@healthlink.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthlink.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ + SOC2 artifacts for APAC-only hosting (HealthLink request)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We can do this. Quick plan:

1) CAIQ: we'll attach a completed CAIQ PDF that includes APAC-specific answers and callouts.
2) SOC 2: we'll provide the 2026 SOC 2 "exhibit snapshot" (redacted vendor list removed) as a zip.
3) Attestation: draft a short attestation for signature (we use DocuSign).
4) VPC egress logs: provide a redacted 24-hour sample (timestamps + destination IPs aggregated, any customer-identifying tokens removed).

Irene, Rishi — can you confirm we can produce the egress sample and the keystore/HSM narrative by EOD Fri PST? Also note HealthLink requested explicit APAC-only hosting and a description of fallback behaviour if regional capacity is constrained.

Alicia — would you accept the artifacts in a shared Drive folder and a DocuSign for the attestation? If you need a different delivery (e.g., encrypted SFTP), let us know.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
[attachment: redwood_caiq_responses_2027-02-25.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@healthlink.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 18:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ + SOC2 artifacts for APAC-only hosting (HealthLink request)

Thanks Naomi. Quick technical note for the record:

- Egress logs: we can export VPC flow logs (sample) for the two APAC subnets used for HealthLink's tenant. We will redact source IPs and internal instance IDs, but include destination IP ranges, ports, and ASN where applicable. The sample file will include a 24h window (2027-02-15 00:00 to 23:59 UTC) and a short README explaining fields.
- Keystore/HSM: we have an HSM-backed keystore for private deploys in APAC; key material for customer tenants is tenant-scoped. We'll provide the keystore control narrative (rotation, split-escrow, operator access controls).
- Fallback behaviour: default routing is regional; if APAC capacity is unavailable we degrade to a compatible APAC region first. We will include the routing policy text that we use for canary/fallback and a mapping of regions.

Note: For the SOC 2 snapshot, we will remove any customer-identifying attachments before sending.

I will prepare the sample log and README and upload to the drive link Naomi shared. Rishi, can you confirm there are no regulatory barriers to providing the 24h sample as described?

Irene Choi
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
[attachment: apac-egress-sample_2027-02-25.log]

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@auditlab.com>

Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:15:00 +1000
Subject: Re: CAIQ + SOC2 artifacts for APAC-only hosting (HealthLink request)

Naomi / Irene — quick follow-up from AuditLab: to accept the VPC egress sample we need:

- The sample in CSV or JSON lines with a short README describing schema.
- SHA256 checksum of the log file and a signed statement that the sample is unmodified during transfer.
- Retention window metadata for that tenant (how long logs are kept before TTL/archival).

If you can provide the checksum and a Docusign-style acknowledgement (or email-signed statement) we can mark this closed on our side. We don't need raw user identifiers.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Senior Auditor, AuditLab
